rationale: The instrument is pinned in a 2-cent daily range with 5-minute ATR of roughly 1.2 bps, while the round-trip spread cost is 2 bps — expected price movement in either direction cannot clear transaction costs. There is no catalyst, no range expansion, and price sits compressed against VWAP and the 9-EMA with no directional information. Long or short is a coin flip with negative expectancy after costs, so the mechanical edge is absent and no entry is justified.
